visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with a high ponytail, wearing a white t-shirt with a green tennis logo and blue jeans, stands in a brightly lit hotel hallway. She knocks on the wooden door of room 501, which has a golden plaque. She carries a cream-colored backpack with a bunny charm attached. (2) Inside the modern bathroom, the woman inspects the chrome showerhead and fixtures. She reaches out to adjust the shower handle, checking the functionality while looking up at the pipes. The background features light-colored square tiles and a glass shower door reflecting the interior lights. (3) The woman stands before a large vanity mirror. Surprisingly, another female figure is visible on the other side of the glass, looking back. They exchange awkward waves and gestures. The setting is a clean, well-lit bathroom with towels and toiletries visible in the background. (4) In the bedroom area, she tugs forcefully on the white duvet, pulling it back with both hands before lying down on the pillows. Later, she holds her smartphone up, using its light to inspect the dark TV screen and the ceiling vents for potential hidden cameras. (5) She returns to the bathroom vanity to test a silver professional-style hairdryer. She holds it up, examining the buttons and the nozzle with a confused and slightly disappointed facial expression. The lighting remains bright, highlighting her facial features and the metallic texture of the device. (6) Finally, she performs a two-way mirror test by pressing her right index finger against the surface of the bathroom mirror. She stares intently at the contact point and displays extreme, exaggerated shock when her finger appears to touch its reflection directly without any gap.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with bright, upbeat synthesized background music. A young female voice speaks rapidly in Mandarin with high arousal and a comedic tone. A sharp, rhythmic "knock-knock-knock" on wood is heard, followed by her polite vocal greeting as she enters an indoor acoustic space. (2) A splashy, bubbling sound effect plays as the sound of running water from a faucet becomes prominent. The woman's voice maintains a fast tempo and clear articulation as she describes checking the water pressure. The music continues in a steady, cheerful loop in the background. (3) A cartoonish "boing" sound effect triggers a transition. A second, softer female voice is heard briefly. The primary speaker's pitch fluctuates as she expresses awkwardness, followed by a lighthearted chime effect that emphasizes the humorous nature of seeing someone in the mirror. (4) Distinct, heavy rustling sounds of fabric and sheets occur as the woman interacts with the bedding. Her voice exhibits slight physical strain and a playful groaning sound. A synthesized "ding" sound effect transitions to her inspecting the room, accompanied by low-level ambient room tone. (5) The mechanical click of a switch is followed by the short, intense whirring sound of a hairdryer motor. The speaker's voice conveys confusion through a rising pitch contour. The BGM rhythm remains consistent, providing a energetic bed for the rapid-fire vocal delivery. (6) A sharp "whoosh" transition sound leads into a dramatic suspense SFX that builds up during the finger test. The audio peaks with a loud, high-pitched vocal exclamation and an exaggerated "impact" sound effect, effectively highlighting the shocking conclusion of the mirror inspection.
